questions.cardText:
[Medical Sciences] What is an adjuvant in vaccines?
A. A type of preservative
B. A substance that enhances the body’s immune response to an antigen
C. A neutralizing agent
Answer: B.
questions.de: Wie heißt ein Stoff, der einem Impfstoff zugesetzt wird, um die Immunantwort des Körpers auf das Antigen zu verstärken?
questions.en: What is the name for a substance added to a vaccine to enhance the body's immune response to its antigen?

timeline.labelEn: The adjuvant effect of aluminium salts, still the most common vaccine adjuvants, is described
timeline.labelDe: Die verstärkende Wirkung von Aluminiumsalzen, bis heute die häufigsten Impfstoff-Adjuvanzien, wird beschrieben

questions.notes: Question and answer swapped so the open question has a short answer.

questions.cardText:
[Performance Art] Which artist used their own body as a canvas and subjected it to various physical tests in performances like “Rhythm 0”?
A. Vito Acconci
B. Marina Abramović
C. Chris Burden
Answer: B. In “Rhythm 0,” Abramović allowed the audience to use 72 objects on her body in any way they desired for over six hours, testing the limits of the relationship between artist and audience. “Rhythm 0” highlighted themes of trust, control, and vulnerability.
questions.de: Welche Künstlerin ließ das Publikum in der sechsstündigen Performance „Rhythm 0“ 72 Gegenstände nach Belieben an ihrem Körper anwenden?
questions.en: Which artist let the audience use 72 objects on her body as they wished in the six-hour performance “Rhythm 0”?

timeline.labelEn: Marina Abramović performs Rhythm 0 at Galleria Studio Morra in Naples
timeline.labelDe: Marina Abramović führt Rhythm 0 in der Galleria Studio Morra in Neapel auf

questions.notes: Wikipedia: six hours (8 pm – 2 am), exactly as planned — the card's 'for over six hours' is slightly off.
